modules.module_title: Work organization and management (Intelligent Security — Core Assessment Criteria

pcs.pc_description: Comply with applicable health, safety, and environmental regulations, including correct selection and use of personal protective equipment (PPE), to ensure safe working practices at all times.
Apply first aid principles and emergency response procedures effectively to address workplace incidents and minimize risk to personnel and assets.
Interpret and adhere to international, national, and organizational standards, regulations, and guidelines relevant to the construction and implementation of security and protection systems.

Maintain accurate records of work progress, design changes, inspections, and test results, ensuring data integrity, security, and traceability for operation and maintenance purposes.
Demonstrate professional development by staying updated with emerging technologies, regulations, systems, and methods, and proactively sharing knowledge and improvement ideas with stakeholders.

modules.module_title: Maintenance and repair — Core Assessment Criteria

pcs.pc_description: Monitor changes in risk profiles and client needs to determine appropriate maintenance, servicing, or upgrade actions for security systems.
Perform routine maintenance and servicing activities in accordance with established security industry maintenance standards and procedures.
Conduct software unit testing and ICT troubleshooting to identify faults and performance issues within security systems.
Test sub-systems and integrated components to verify correct operation or diagnose malfunctions accurately.
Inspect systems to identify problems such as loose or damaged connections, component degradation, or equipment failure.
Evaluate repair versus replacement options and carry out corrective actions to restore system functionality effectively.
Verify that existing security systems continue to meet current technical, safety, and regulatory standards.
Advise clients on equipment upgrades, regulatory changes, and functional improvements to maintain system effectiveness and client confidence.
Implement sustainable practices by recycling replaced equipment and materials in accordance with environmental guidelines.
Provide backup, disaster recovery support, and coordinate multi-system operational maintenance while completing and sharing required reports and documentation with relevant stakeholders.
